scope: Extend the generated AC1024 rooted associative-graph whole-file transaction profile to nine inline constraint nodes and close one distance constraint's value dependency, dimension dependency, variable, dimension entity, and dimension dependency body references.

source.profile: NOD ACAD_ASSOCNETWORK -> association DICTIONARY -> NETWORK -> owned 2D constraint GROUP -> six owned dependencies (four geometry, one value, one dimension) -> one LINE, one ARC, one CIRCLE, one associative variable, one linear dimension, and one ACDBASSOCDIMDEPENDENCYBODY. The nine ordered inline nodes are implicit point, AcFixedConstraint, horizontal constraint, circle, datum line, bounded line, arc, AcConstrainedRigidSet, and AcDistanceConstraint. The distance node references the value and dimension dependencies; the group action list closes all six dependencies; the dimension dependency targets the linear dimension and references its body; the value dependency targets the owned associative variable; reciprocal reactor/ownership links are checked.

implementation.change: Expanded the generated whole-file allocation sweep with an AcDistanceConstraint and fully graph-closed ACDBASSOCVALUEDEPENDENCY, ACDBASSOCDEPENDENCY, ACDBASSOCDIMDEPENDENCYBODY, associative variable, and linear-dimension target records. Added complete authored prefix profiles, action-list membership, owner and reactor links, group counts, and typed readback/source-immutability checks for the new graph nodes and fields.
implementation.method: For ASCII and Binary, calibrate the complete OBJECTS callback, inject std::bad_alloc at each reached allocation offset, require failed publication with byte-identical destination sentinel and unchanged source graph, then retry the same adapter and verify fresh typed readback of the root graph, nine inline nodes, six dependencies, variable and dimension targets, body reference, and reciprocal ownership/action/reactor edges.

validation.ascii: 136/136 callback allocation offsets injected; destination and source graph preserved; same-adapter retry and typed nine-node graph readback passed.
validation.binary: 133/133 callback allocation offsets injected; destination and source graph preserved; same-adapter retry and typed nine-node graph readback passed.

limitations: Generated transaction and codec-readback evidence only; it does not establish producer prevalence, native constraint solving, independent source-profile layout, or constraint semantics.
Only one real-valued dependency and one linear-dimension target/body profile are included; other value variants, dimension entity classes, and dependency states remain outside this vector.
No DWG/DXF fixture files were added, and no support claim is promoted.
